name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: August Week 10 - Prototype Build
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.example: The starter sketch gave the group a working first test.

words.definition: A circuit part that detects distance, light, touch, or another condition.
words.example: The sensor detected the hand near the project.

words.definition: A sensor value sent into the prototype code.
words.example: The sensor value became the input for the code.

words.definition: The steps a system or program uses.
words.example: The process compared the reading to the threshold.

words.definition: The prototype action produced after the code checks the sensor value.
words.example: The output turned on the buzzer when the object was close.

words.definition: To test wiring and code one part at a time until the prototype works.
words.example: The team can debug the sketch by checking one line at a time.

words.definition: A code rule that decides which prototype output should happen.
words.example: The condition controlled when the warning light appeared.
